acceptance_tests.assertion: All status labels remain readable and not color-only.
acceptance_tests.evidence: docs/evidence/gates/u005-rehearsal.log line 29: 'review status label: 1:1 < 4.5:1 (rgb(181,170,159) on rgb(181,170,159))' plus three elements that returned undefined (harness selector misses). rehearsal_failures.observed: review status label 1:1 (rgb(181,170,159) on rgb(181,170,159)); qc badge / select control / subset banner returned undefined
rehearsal_failures.triage: UNRESOLVED. --text-muted is #b5aa9f and is documented in tokens.css as 7.26:1 on --surface, and it is defined in BOTH the light block (line 134) and the dark block (line 176). A measured 1:1 therefore implies the measured element's background resolved to the same colour, not that the token itself is wrong. Which selector the rehearsal used was not recoverable from the record, so the offending rule is not yet identified. A 1:1 text label is invisible and is the most serious of the four.

rehearsal_failures.check: no console errors during the switch
rehearsal_failures.triage: UNRESOLVED AND REPRODUCED INDEPENDENTLY. Phase 0 saw the same 503s in the shared preview tab while my isolated Playwright sweep ran 5/5 against the same stack. All recent thumbnail requests returned 200 and the API log contains no 5xx. Suspected: a single-worker uvicorn saturating under two concurrent browser clients, i.e. harness/dev-server capacity rather than U005. Not confirmed, therefore not dismissed.

rehearsal_failures.check: one live subscription per mounted control, none left dangling
rehearsal_failures.triage: MISCALIBRATED CHECK, NOT A LEAK. app/g6/frontend/src/main.tsx renders <StrictMode>, so React 18 mounts, unmounts and remounts in development. addEventListener runs twice and removeEventListener once, leaving exactly one live listener on a mounted control — which is the intended steady state. The rehearsal asserted add===remove without accounting for StrictMode.

rehearsal_failures.check: AT04 no frame painted the light canvas before the stored dark theme was applied
rehearsal_failures.triage: UNRESOLVED, LIKELY HARNESS. main.tsx calls applyStoredPreference() before createRoot().render, which is the correct anti-FOUC mechanism. The two observed frames both report data-theme=null AND background rgba(0,0,0,0) — fully transparent, i.e. nothing painted yet — rather than a light canvas. The recording appears to start before the pre-render call takes effect. Not proven.
